name: Sab-Sunen, Luxa Embodied
prompt: Build a Simic (G/U) +1/+1 counters and card-draw deck for Sab-Sunen, Luxa Embodied. The commander grows with counters and rewards odd counts with two cards drawn each turn, so prioritize: cheap counter doublers (Hardened Scales, Branching Evolution, Doubling Season, Kalonian Hydra), proliferate effects (Inexorable Tide, Tezzeret's Gambit, Karn's Bastion), and creatures that thrive with counters (Hangarback Walker, Walking Ballista, Master Biomancer, Forgotten Ancient). Add solid blue card draw (Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Beast Whisperer), mana ramp (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Cultivate, Kodama's Reach, Three Visits, Nature's Lore), counterspell protection (Counterspell, Swan Song, Mana Drain), and a few proliferate-friendly win conditions like Walking Ballista or Triskelion. Mid-budget, no infinite combos required, fun midrange tempo gameplay.
description: LLM timed out; deck assembled from prioritized local candidates.
